tasks.title: Set your total wedding budget
tasks.description: Discuss finances with your partner and families to determine total available budget.

tasks.title: Create a wedding vision board
tasks.description: Collect inspiration images, color palettes, and theme ideas on Pinterest or a physical board.

tasks.title: Research and visit potential venues
tasks.description: Create a shortlist of 5-8 venues, schedule site visits, and compare pricing packages.

tasks.title: Book your wedding venue
tasks.description: Sign the contract, pay the deposit, and confirm the date with your chosen venue.

tasks.title: Start your guest list draft
tasks.description: Create an initial guest list with both families. Categorize by family, friends, and colleagues.

tasks.title: Choose your wedding party
tasks.description: Ask bridesmaids, groomsmen, flower girl, ring bearer, and other attendants.

tasks.title: Research and book a photographer
tasks.description: Review portfolios, meet 3-4 photographers, compare packages and styles.

tasks.title: Research and book a videographer
tasks.description: Watch sample wedding films, meet potential videographers, and book your favorite.

tasks.title: Hire a wedding planner or coordinator
tasks.description: Interview planners, check references, and decide on full-service or day-of coordination.

tasks.title: Start shopping for wedding dress
tasks.description: Research designers, book boutique appointments, and begin trying on gowns.

tasks.title: Research and book caterer
tasks.description: Schedule tastings with 3-4 caterers, compare menus and pricing.

tasks.title: Book ceremony officiant
tasks.description: Meet with potential officiants, discuss ceremony style and personalization.

tasks.title: Research entertainment options
tasks.description: Decide between a DJ or live band, attend showcases or watch demo videos.

tasks.title: Book band or DJ
tasks.description: Sign contract and confirm song preferences, must-play and do-not-play lists.

tasks.title: Reserve hotel room blocks
tasks.description: Negotiate group rates at nearby hotels for out-of-town guests.

tasks.title: Order your wedding dress
tasks.description: Place the order for your chosen gown, confirm delivery timeline for alterations.

tasks.title: Start engagement photo session
tasks.description: Schedule and complete engagement photos for save-the-dates and wedding website.

tasks.title: Create wedding website
tasks.description: Build your wedding website with event details, registry links, RSVP form, and travel info.

tasks.title: Send save-the-dates
tasks.description: Mail save-the-dates to all guests, especially those traveling from out of town.

tasks.title: Register for wedding gifts
tasks.description: Create registries at 2-3 stores covering various price points and categories.

tasks.title: Research and hire florist
tasks.description: Meet with florists, discuss seasonal availability, and choose your floral design style.

tasks.title: Plan ceremony details
tasks.description: Write vows, choose readings, select ceremony music, and plan processional order.

tasks.title: Research and book baker or dessert vendor
tasks.description: Schedule cake tastings, choose flavors, design, and confirm delivery logistics.

tasks.title: Plan bridesmaids dresses
tasks.description: Choose style, color, and ordering timeline for bridesmaids attire.

tasks.title: Order bridesmaids dresses
tasks.description: Place orders with enough lead time for delivery and alterations.

tasks.title: Plan groomsmen attire
tasks.description: Choose suits or tuxedos, coordinate colors, and schedule fittings.

tasks.title: Finalize guest list
tasks.description: Confirm final guest count with both families, verify all addresses.

tasks.title: Design and order wedding invitations
tasks.description: Work with a designer or choose a template, order proofs, and place the final order.

tasks.title: Plan reception layout
tasks.description: Work with venue coordinator on floor plan, table arrangements, and flow.

tasks.title: Book transportation
tasks.description: Arrange limo, vintage car, or shuttle service for the wedding party and guests.

tasks.title: Schedule hair and makeup trial
tasks.description: Book trials with 2-3 artists, bring inspiration photos and your veil/headpiece.

tasks.title: Book hair and makeup artist
tasks.description: Confirm your chosen artist and finalize the look for you and bridal party.

tasks.title: Choose wedding favors
tasks.description: Select and order personalized favors for guests.

tasks.title: Plan rehearsal dinner
tasks.description: Choose venue, create guest list, and plan menu for the rehearsal dinner.

tasks.title: Apply for marriage license
tasks.description: Research requirements in your state/county, gather documents, and apply.

tasks.title: Plan honeymoon
tasks.description: Research destinations, book flights, hotel, and plan activities.

tasks.title: Book honeymoon travel
tasks.description: Purchase flights, confirm hotel reservations, and buy travel insurance.

tasks.title: Finalize decor and rental items
tasks.description: Confirm centerpieces, linens, lighting, signage, and rental furniture.

tasks.title: Shop for wedding rings
tasks.description: Visit jewelers, choose bands, allow time for sizing and engraving.

tasks.title: Mail wedding invitations
tasks.description: Assemble, stamp, and mail all invitations. Include RSVP cards with deadline.

tasks.title: Begin dress alterations
tasks.description: Schedule 2-3 fitting appointments for wedding dress alterations.

tasks.title: Finalize ceremony music and readings
tasks.description: Confirm all ceremony music selections and reader assignments.

tasks.title: Create day-of timeline
tasks.description: Build a detailed minute-by-minute schedule for the wedding day.

tasks.title: Confirm all vendor details
tasks.description: Contact every vendor to reconfirm dates, times, locations, and deliverables.

tasks.title: Track RSVPs and follow up
tasks.description: Monitor responses, follow up with non-responders by phone or text.

tasks.title: Create seating chart
tasks.description: Assign tables based on relationships, avoid conflicts, balance table sizes.

tasks.title: Submit final headcount to caterer
tasks.description: Provide confirmed guest count and meal selections to your caterer.

tasks.title: Final dress fitting
tasks.description: Complete last alterations and pick up your finished wedding gown.

tasks.title: Prepare wedding day emergency kit
tasks.description: Assemble a kit with sewing supplies, pain relief, stain remover, snacks, and touch-up items.

tasks.title: Write thank-you notes for early gifts
tasks.description: Begin writing thank-you notes for gifts received before the wedding.

tasks.title: Finalize ceremony vows
tasks.description: Complete and practice your personalized wedding vows.

tasks.title: Confirm honeymoon details
tasks.description: Double-check flights, hotel, transfers, passports, and travel documents.

tasks.title: Order place cards and menus
tasks.description: Design and print personalized place cards and reception menus.

tasks.title: Plan wedding party gifts
tasks.description: Choose and purchase thank-you gifts for bridesmaids, groomsmen, and parents.

tasks.title: Schedule rehearsal and rehearsal dinner
tasks.description: Coordinate timing with officiant, wedding party, and venue for the rehearsal.

tasks.title: Break in your wedding shoes
tasks.description: Wear your ceremony shoes around the house to avoid blisters on the big day.

tasks.title: Attend rehearsal and rehearsal dinner
tasks.description: Walk through the ceremony, distribute timeline, and celebrate with close family.

tasks.title: Prepare vendor payments and tips
tasks.description: Prepare final payments and tip envelopes for all vendors.

tasks.title: Pack for the honeymoon
tasks.description: Pack bags and confirm all travel documents are ready.

tasks.title: Delegate day-of responsibilities
tasks.description: Assign specific tasks to wedding party members and coordinator.

tasks.title: Confirm final timeline with all vendors
tasks.description: Send the finalized day-of timeline to every vendor and wedding party member.

tasks.title: Enjoy your wedding day
tasks.description: Take a deep breath, trust your planning, and celebrate the love of your life!

tasks.title: Research rental companies for tables and chairs
tasks.description: Get quotes from 3+ rental companies for reception furniture.

tasks.title: Book rental items
tasks.description: Reserve tables, chairs, linens, tableware, and specialty items.

tasks.title: Choose and order wedding cake topper
tasks.description: Select a custom or pre-made cake topper that matches your style.

tasks.title: Plan welcome bags for hotel guests
tasks.description: Assemble welcome bags with snacks, water, itinerary, and local info.

tasks.title: Schedule final vendor walk-through
tasks.description: Do a site visit with key vendors to walk through logistics and layout.

tasks.title: Pick up marriage license
tasks.description: Visit the county clerk to obtain your marriage license before it expires.

tasks.title: Arrange parking plan for guests
tasks.description: Coordinate valet, shuttle, or parking lot logistics for wedding day.

tasks.title: Plan post-wedding brunch
tasks.description: Organize a casual brunch for the morning after the wedding for close guests.

tasks.title: Finalize reception playlist
tasks.description: Create must-play and do-not-play lists, plan special dance songs.

tasks.title: Coordinate flower girl and ring bearer outfits
tasks.description: Shop for or order outfits and accessories for young attendants.

tasks.title: Confirm photo shot list with photographer
tasks.description: Create a list of must-have photos: family groupings, details, key moments.

tasks.title: Start a skincare routine
tasks.description: Begin a consistent skincare regimen for clear, glowing skin on your wedding day.

tasks.title: Schedule teeth whitening
tasks.description: Plan professional whitening treatments to finish 2 weeks before the wedding.

tasks.title: Plan ceremony exit toss
tasks.description: Choose confetti, petals, bubbles, or sparklers for the ceremony exit.

tasks.title: Write ceremony program
tasks.description: Design and print ceremony programs listing participants and order of service.

tasks.title: Plan cocktail hour details
tasks.description: Decide on passed appetizers, bar setup, entertainment, and flow.

tasks.title: Review insurance options
tasks.description: Research wedding insurance policies covering cancellation, liability, and weather.

tasks.title: Plan bachelor and bachelorette parties
tasks.description: Coordinate dates, destinations, and activities with the wedding party.

tasks.title: Arrange childcare for the reception
tasks.description: Hire babysitters or set up a kids room for guests with children.

tasks.title: Plan first dance choreography
tasks.description: Take dance lessons or practice your first dance routine.

tasks.title: Order groom's suit or tuxedo
tasks.description: Purchase or rent the groom's attire, schedule fitting appointments.

tasks.title: Arrange accessibility accommodations
tasks.description: Ensure venue accessibility for elderly or disabled guests: ramps, seating, restrooms.

tasks.title: Choose wedding hashtag
tasks.description: Create a unique, memorable wedding hashtag for social media and signage.

tasks.title: Plan table numbers and signage
tasks.description: Design and order table numbers, welcome signs, and directional signage.

tasks.title: Schedule final beauty appointments
tasks.description: Book day-of hair, makeup, nails, and any last-minute beauty treatments.

tasks.title: Arrange ceremony readings and readers
tasks.description: Choose meaningful readings and invite friends or family to participate.

tasks.title: Plan garter and bouquet toss
tasks.description: Decide whether to include traditional tosses and prepare accordingly.

tasks.title: Confirm day-of emergency contacts
tasks.description: Share emergency contact list with wedding party and coordinator.
